race.comment: ASTARI (2) raced wide and got the job done in this grade at Echuca in his penultimate start, and then loomed large wide at Ballarat last time out before peaking on his effort, finishing sixth. He drops back again into BM56 company, and is expected to bounce straight back into the money. MR TICKLES (1) has only battled in a couple of tougher recent assignments, and he drops right down in class for this, and with a 3kg claim to offset his weight rise, a form reversal is on the cards. Each way. JUST REMEMBER IT (4) can fire up fresh for a new stable. FREE TO PLAY (9) returned at long odds last start and finished 4 lengths adrift in fourth over 1000m at Moe. Can improve into a place.
